test_title: PYST 10: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 10 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

# : KSM :: OWQ : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

Given:

# : KSM :: OWQ : %

**Option 1) # = LTM, % = NVP**

**For # (LTM) to KSM**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b527beb1df87426fe0afc5b570a4c5e222819fc30543e81658066bdf55b6f43.png] 

**For OWQ to % (NVP)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9aecede7b98fe0c4a0ea53815d3ff872a214acc2d5f9d6637c6fe34c0b531b9.png] 

 

Since the pattern for LTM to KSM (-1, -1, 0) is not the same as the pattern for OWQ to NVP (-1, -1, -1), Option 1 is incorrect.

**Option 2) # = LTN, % = NVP**

**For # (LTN) to KSM**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92c40da84ce762c6aead937a5492849f129605462110002e34ddb31eecad2f34.png] 

 

**For OWQ to % (NVP)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ba5fa2100c277490f7a3a6559a3879b7d4a643b822d08060b80059c657c345f.png] 

 

Since the pattern for LTN to KSM (-1, -1, -1) is the same as the pattern for OWQ to NVP (-1, -1, -1), Option 2 is correct.

**Option 3) # = LTN, % = NUP**

**For # (LTN) to KSM**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/465c73f6556be0c9857fd2222c893e7b68fb7f8077d467c5f3926bea36d6a6bf.png] 

 

**For OWQ to % (NUP)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e8f45fcac4b1d2ac76560c1f0647cc7f1f260fbedfa4f7349195efc96aed754.png] 

 

Since the pattern for LTN to KSM (-1, -1, -1) is not the same as the pattern for OWQ to NUP (-1, -2, -1), Option 3 is incorrect.

**Option 4) # = LTN, % = NVO**

**For # (LTN) to KSM**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06b5e5d33f20049bf1fe55388599a113b48da8510844834d1cf28318a951f766.png] 

 

**For OWQ to % (NVO)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72b2d80c7f24c7f3f28bf91fdf3803e2cc8d8de13c4753a3b97bf7207ac78406.png] 

 

Since the pattern for LTN to KSM (-1, -1, -1) is not the same as the pattern for OWQ to NVO (-1, -1, -2), Option 4 is incorrect.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
